On-Chain Operator. Module 14 · Automation and mastery. Navy and cyan. This is the door, not the whole module. Education only.
You already have a playbook. Automation may watch it. Automation may not hold your keys.
By the end of the module you will be able to do this: monitor and automate safely, run multisig operations, and complete the operator capstone. Not before. The lessons earn it one page at a time.

The lessons, in order, are 14.0 Mastery Starter, 14.1 Monitoring: dashboards, alerts and on-chain watchers, 14.2 Automation: keepers, bots and agents without handing over the keys, 14.3 Operating procedures: multisig signing, change control, reviews, 14.4 Operator capstone and certification, 14.5 Building your own tools: reading contracts, data and simple scripts, 14.6 Searchers, keepers and arbitrage bots: how they work. You do not skip ahead. Each page is the input to the next.
Lesson 14.0, Mastery Starter. Mastery Starter. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 14.1, Monitoring: dashboards, alerts and on-chain watchers. Set up monitoring so you hear about problems before they cost money. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 14.2, Automation: keepers, bots and agents without handing over the keys. Automate routine actions with the least permission possible. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 14.3, Operating procedures: multisig signing, change control, reviews. Run your bank with procedures that prevent single-point mistakes. You will write that down when you get there.
Lesson 14.4, Operator capstone and certification. Assemble your complete on-chain bank and have it assessed. You will write that down when you get there.

Lesson 14.5, Building your own tools: reading contracts, data and simple scripts. Read on-chain data directly and build simple read-only tools, so you're not dependent on any one dashboard. You will write that down when you get there.

Lesson 14.6, Searchers, keepers and arbitrage bots: how they work. Understand the professional bot economy that shapes DeFi prices, and why competing in it is hard. You will write that down when you get there.
Next is Lesson 14.0, Mastery Starter. Bring nothing but the habit: one idea, one drawing, the word Example on any number. Education only, not financial advice.
